item.title: Hachette UK and Union Square announce new global sales and distribution partnership
item.description: 11 December 2025, London, UK - Hachette UK is pleased to announce that Union Square, formerly Sterling Publishing, will be joining them for sales representation in 2026. Union Square, which is already distributed by Hachette UK Distribution, are currently represented by Pinnacle Booksales in UK sales channels. item.title: Ella Patel appointed Head of DEI
item.description: 14 January 2026, London UK – Award-winning publicist, Ella Patel, has been appointed Head of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at Hachette UK. Effective immediately, and reporting to Group HR Director Lisa Waterman, Ella will be instrumental in Hachette’s ongoing, industry-leading commitment to Changing the Story, which ensures that all voices, perspectives, and ideas are included in its partnerships, people, and publishing. item.title: Hachette UK Achieves Age Inclusive Accreditation with 55/Redefined as it Builds an Intergenerational Future
item.description: Book publisher commits to the over 50s workplace, becoming an Age-Inclusive Accredited employer.
